headless-ci.description: Headless-safe CI lane: only checks that can execute without a local RenderingDevice.

release-ci.description: Canonical release-ready runtime validation profile: the non-headless GDScript runtime suite plus a required renderer proof. Wired as a nightly + workflow_dispatch evidence lane in .github/workflows/release_ci_runtime.yml on the self-hosted Linux GPU runner (GDScript tests only, --skip-cpp). NOT run by baseline QA CI, which runs headless-ci; the GPU-backed streaming gate is streaming-gpu-ci.

node-asset-gpu-ci.description: Focused GPU-backed proof that a canonical GaussianSplatNode3D renders a fixture GaussianSplatAsset and produces visual evidence. Not directly wired to a workflow; its Canonical Node Asset Render scenario is exercised nightly through the release-ci lane (release_ci_runtime.yml).

painterly-gpu-ci.description: Focused GPU-backed proof that the painterly raster path actually runs when a PainterlyMaterial is authored on GaussianSplatNode3D, and that its frame is not the baseline's (#997, #851). Not directly wired to a workflow; its Painterly Material Render scenario is exercised nightly through the release-ci lane (release_ci_runtime.yml).

streaming-gpu-ci.description: Canonical GPU-backed streaming validation gate for runtime residency and world-streaming regressions; fails the gpu-tests job of baseline_qa.yml but is not a required status check; benchmark proof surfaces live in the benchmark workflow.

gs-combined-1.description: GS-COMBINED-1 hard gate (docs/architecture/adr-one-route-many-producers.md section 9): the combined game scene (streamed world, 32 movable objects, pick target, animated mesh character, 1 directional + 4 omni lights with shadows) in variant A (chunk-streamed world) and variant B (V4 paged HLOD world). A scenario passes only when gs_combined_1_verdict.py reports every assertion live-pass; blocked assertions are listed in gs_combined_1_expectations.json and stay red. Run by .github/workflows/gs_combined_1.yml as a reported, not yet required, check.

stress-only.description: Stress-focused runtime lane for local and CI soak checks.

smoke.description: Fast local smoke profile for quick runtime sanity checks.
